prompt_cn:
【服装资产图】16:9 横版设计稿，用于 AI 漫剧资产库
主体：破损军用风衣
服装：内层 + 中间层 + 外层 + 腰带配件, 功能性与辨识度兼顾的廓形
材质：棉, 均匀轻微使用痕迹
装备：一件与身份匹配的标志性配件
配色：深灰黑 + 暗红
版式：左侧半身/头部特写（验五官与材质）；右侧正 / 严格 90° 侧 / 背 三视图
一致性：三视图必须同一角色，头身比 / 服装 / 装备 / 配色 / 材质完全一致
姿态：自然站立，双脚微开，双臂自然下垂，不做剧情动作
背景：纯白或极浅灰影棚背景，无环境叙事
光影：柔和均匀棚拍光，无强烈硬阴影，便于辨认材质
品质：8K 超清、拟真影视级概念设计稿质感
prompt_en:
Create a professional 16:9 landscape COSTUME design sheet for a cinematic AI-animation / game production asset library.
GARMENT: 破损军用风衣 (military)
LAYERS: base layer + mid layer + outer layer + belt accessories
SILHOUETTE: functional, readable silhouette
MATERIALS: cotton, even, light wear
CONSTRUCTION: base layer + mid layer + outer layer + belt accessories
COLOUR: dark grey-black and dark red
WEAR: even, light wear
ACCESSORIES: one signature accessory matching the station
LAYOUT: Costume design sheet, 16:9, pure white background, seamless white studio background, left side: fabric and construction detail close-up, right side: front view, side view, back view, flat garment presentation, soft even lighting, cinematic lighting quality, high detail, material accurate, no text, no logo, no watermark
CONSISTENCY: all views must show exactly the same garment with identical cut, construction, layer order, colour, material, trim and degree of wear; flat garment presentation; do not redesign between views.
BACKGROUND: pure white background or seamless white studio background, no environmental scene, no scenery, no props.
LIGHTING: soft even studio lighting, subtle ambient illumination, soft contact shadow, no harsh shadows, cinematic lighting quality — so that fabric, skin, metal and leather read clearly.
CINEMATIC QUALITY (concrete, not just the word 'cinematic'): controlled key light, soft fill, subtle rim light, physically plausible falloff, controlled contrast, cinematic depth, foreground / midground / background separation, restrained color palette, material separation
STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic hyper-detailed character design, professional game character design sheet. Quality targets: photorealistic / lifelike priority; ultra-high detail; 8K-level visual detail; cinematic lighting quality.
